## Callouts & Bubbles

Speech and thought bubbles for annotating or quoting — these are designed to hold text.

::: {.shape-speech-bubble .shape-fill-blue .shape-md}
Hello!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-round .shape-fill-green .shape-md}
Hi!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-rounded .shape-fill-red .shape-md}
Hey!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-oval .shape-fill-purple .shape-md}
Yo!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-thought .shape-fill-blue .shape-md}
Hmm...
:::
::: {.shape-callout-cloud .shape-fill-white .shape-stroke-blue .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
Poof
:::
::: {.shape-callout-explosion .shape-fill-yellow .shape-md}
Boom!
:::

## Fill & Stroke

These are not separate shapes — they show modifier classes (`.shape-fill-*`, `.shape-stroke-*`) applied to any shape above.

::: {.shape-circle .shape-fill-none .shape-stroke-blue .shape-stroke-lg .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-star .shape-fill-red .shape-stroke-black .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-cube .shape-fill-blue .shape-stroke-black .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::

## Rotation

Also a modifier, not a shape group — the `.shape-rotate-*` classes turn any shape in 45° steps.

::: {.shape-triangle .shape-fill-purple .shape-rotate-180 .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-arrow .shape-fill-blue .shape-rotate-90 .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-moon .shape-fill-yellow .shape-rotate-270 .shape-md}
:::
